newsitem.title: USA: Mercantile viewed as takeover target-report.
newsitem.headline: Mercantile viewed as takeover target-report.

text.p: Federated Department Stores Inc and May Department Stores Co are seen as likely suitors to acquire Mercantile Stores Co Inc, Business Week's Inside Wall Street column reported.

A "New York banker" told the magazine that Federated made a $75-a-share bid for Mercantile, but management rejected the offer. The banker expects Federated to make a sweetened offer in the $80 to $90 a share range, the magazine said.
Mercantile and Federated were not immediately available for comment.
A May spokeswoman said the company has a policy of not commenting on rumors or speculation.
An investment manager told the magazine that Mercantile's directors, led by the Milliken family that controls 40 percent of the company, think the shares are worth $100.
Federated or May would benefit from Mercantile's strong presence in the South and the Midwest, the magazine said.
